description: Source code for the PredicateQuery class implementing IPredicateQuery, handling SQL query predicate logic with alias and parameter management in OrchardCore Content Management GraphQL module.

classes.name: PredicateQuery
classes.description: Implements IPredicateQuery, manages SQL predicate creation with alias and parameter handling, supports multiple SQL dialects.

methods.name: NewQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a new SQL parameter with a unique name and adds it to the Parameters dictionary.

methods.name: CreateAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a given property path, with optional partial flag.

methods.name: CreateTableAlias
methods.description: Creates a table alias for a given property path.

methods.name: SearchUsedAlias
methods.description: Tracks usage of aliases based on property paths.

methods.name: GetColumnName
methods.description: Retrieves the properly quoted column name or alias for a property path.

methods.name: GetUsedAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of aliases used in the query.

methods.name: EnsureQuotes
methods.description: Ensures that a given alias or column name is properly quoted based on the SQL dialect.

methods.name: IndexOfUnquoted
methods.description: Finds the index of a character outside quoted segments in a string.

methods.name: GetQuoteChars
methods.description: Returns the quote characters for a given SQL dialect.

methods.name: ExtractQuoteChars
methods.description: Extracts quote characters from a dialect's quote string.
